evidence.quote: De opleiding wordt voornamelijk in het Engels aangeboden met een "soft landing" in jaar één waarin meerdere vakken, projecten en studentbegeleiding beschikbaar zijn in het Nederlands en Engels.

notes: Intake: the only dated deadline (1 mei 2027) is a general Studielink deadline on this programme's page and is not explicitly labelled for non-EU/international applicants, so it was recorded as a recurring day/month (1 May) rather than a fixed 2027 date. No tuition figure for non-EU students is stated for this programme: the Collegegeld page only says an institution fee applies to non-EEA students, with the amount set by the Executive Board and varying per programme, and refers to a collegegeldmeter (not in the supplied texts), so tuition was left out. Teaching language: the pages say the Bachelor is officially Dutch ('Taal Nederlands') but also that it is 'voornamelijk in het Engels' aangeboden; en was recorded and this conflict is flagged for the auditor.
